meta.notes: Pavilions are real national pavilions from Expo 2025 Osaka, placed on our own Expo 2030 Riyadh map. Zones follow the five Expo 2030 Riyadh sub-themes (BIE). Images are from Wikimedia Commons.
meta.coordinates: x and y from 0 to 1000, center (500,500), north is y=0, south main gate at the bottom.
meta.paths: Each path links two points by type and name (ZONE, ENTRANCE, PAVILION). Distance is calculated from x and y.
meta.accessibility: Demo accessibility data for testing (Expo 2030 is not open yet). Each pavilion has a status per need: ACCESSIBLE, PARTIAL or NOT_ACCESSIBLE. Paths have stepFree (no stairs) and shaded.
meta.crowd: Demo crowd data: capacity is how many people the pavilion holds at once, avgVisitMinutes is the usual time inside. Used to estimate the queue from the roadmaps.
